items.name: CommitResult
items.summary: The result of attempting to commit this transaction. If the commit was successful/conflicted/retryable, the result is Ok(CommitResult), otherwise, if a nonrecoverable error occurred, the result is Err(Error).

methods.name: is_committed
methods.summary: Returns true if the commit was successful.

items.name: AlterTable
items.summary: Marker type for alter-table (schema evolution) transactions.

items.name: CommittedTransaction
items.summary: This is the result of a successfully committed [Transaction]. One can retrieve the [post_commit_stats], [commit version], and optionally the [post-commit snapshot] from this struct.

methods.name: commit_version
methods.summary: The version of the table that was just sucessfully committed

methods.name: post_commit_snapshot
methods.summary: The [`SnapshotRef`] of the table after this transaction was committed.

methods.name: post_commit_stats
methods.summary: The [`PostCommitStats`] for this transaction

items.name: ConflictedTransaction
items.summary: This is the result of a conflicted [Transaction]. One can retrieve the [conflict version] from this struct. In the future a rebase API will be provided (issue #1389).

methods.name: conflict_version
methods.summary: The version attempted commit that yielded a conflict

items.name: ExistingTable
items.summary: Marker type for transactions on existing tables.

items.name: PostCommitStats
items.summary: Kernel exposes information about the state of the table that engines might want to use to trigger actions like checkpointing or log compaction. This struct holds that information.

items.name: RetryableTransaction
items.summary: A transaction that failed to commit due to a retryable error (e.g. IO error). The transaction can be recovered with `RetryableTransaction::transaction` and retried without rebasing. The associated error can be inspected via `RetryableTrans…

items.name: Transaction
items.summary: A transaction represents an in-progress write to a table. After creating a transaction, changes to the table may be staged via the transaction methods before calling `commit` to commit the changes to the table.

methods.name: add_files
methods.signature: fn add_files(&mut self, add_metadata: Box<dyn EngineData>)
methods.summary: Add files to include in this transaction. This API generally enables the engine to add/append/insert data (files) to the table. Note that this API can be called multiple times to add multiple batches.

methods.name: add_files_schema
methods.summary: The schema that the [`Engine`]'s [`ParquetHandler`] is expected to use when reporting information about a Parquet write operation back to Kernel.

methods.name: commit
methods.summary: Consume the transaction and commit it to the table. The result is a result of [CommitResult] with the following semantics: - Ok(CommitResult) for either success or a recoverable error (includes the failed   transaction in case of a conflic…

methods.name: logical_partition_columns
methods.summary: Returns the logical partition column names for this table.

methods.name: partitioned_write_context
methods.signature: fn partitioned_write_context(&self, partition_values: HashMap<String, Scalar>) -> DeltaResult<WriteContext>
methods.summary: Creates a write context for writing data to a specific partition.

methods.name: remove_files
methods.summary: Remove files from the table in this transaction. This API generally enables the engine to delete data (at file-level granularity) from the table. Note that this API can be called multiple times to remove multiple batches.

methods.name: scan_metadata_to_engine_data
methods.signature: fn scan_metadata_to_engine_data(scan_metadata: impl Iterator<Item = DeltaResult<scan::ScanMetadata>>) -> impl Iterator<Item = DeltaResult<FilteredEngineData>>
methods.summary: Helper function to convert scan metadata iterator to filtered engine data iterator.

methods.name: set_data_change
methods.summary: Same as [`Transaction::with_data_change`] but set the value directly instead of using a fluent API.

methods.name: stats_columns
methods.summary: Returns the list of column names that should have statistics collected.

methods.name: stats_schema
methods.summary: Returns the expected schema for file statistics.

methods.name: unpartitioned_write_context
methods.summary: Creates a write context for writing data to an unpartitioned table.

methods.name: update_deletion_vectors
methods.signature: fn update_deletion_vectors(&mut self, new_dv_descriptors: HashMap<String, DeletionVectorDescriptor>, existing_data_files: impl Iterator<Item = DeltaResult<FilteredEngineData>>) -> DeltaResult<()>
methods.summary: Update deletion vectors for files in the table.

methods.name: with_blind_append
methods.summary: Mark this transaction as a blind append.

methods.name: with_commit_info
methods.signature: fn with_commit_info(self, engine_commit_info: Box<dyn EngineData>, commit_info_schema: SchemaRef) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the content of the commitInfo action for this transaction. Note that kernel will _always_ write a commitInfo, this function simply allows engines to add their own data into that action if they wish. Note that the following fields in `e…

methods.name: with_correlation_id
methods.signature: fn with_correlation_id(self, correlation_id: impl Into<Arc<str>>) -> Self
methods.summary: Attach an opaque, caller-supplied correlation id for joining this transaction's commit metric events to the caller's own request or operation id. An empty id is treated as unset. When unset, behavior is unchanged.

methods.name: with_data_change
methods.summary: Set the data change flag.

methods.name: with_domain_metadata
methods.signature: fn with_domain_metadata(self, domain: String, configuration: String) -> Self

methods.name: with_domain_metadata_removed
methods.summary: Remove domain metadata from the Delta log. If the domain exists in the Delta log, this creates a tombstone to logically delete the domain. The tombstone preserves the previous configuration value. If the domain does not exist in the Delta…

methods.name: with_engine_info
methods.signature: fn with_engine_info(self, engine_info: impl Into<String>) -> Self
methods.summary: Set the engine info field of this transaction's commit info action. This field is optional.

methods.name: with_operation
methods.summary: Set the operation that this transaction is performing. This string will be persisted in the commit and visible to anyone who describes the table history.

methods.name: with_transaction_id
methods.signature: fn with_transaction_id(self, app_id: String, version: i64) -> Self

items.name: SupportsDataFiles
items.summary: Marker trait for transaction states that support data file operations.
